settings.name: OIDF_EVENTS_AUDIT
settings.description: Whether events marked as audit also go to PingFederate's audit.log; every event goes to server.log either way

when_wrong.detail: Neither true nor false, in any case: audit stays on, with a warning

settings.name: OIDF_EVENTS_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH
settings.description: The longest value an event line carries; a longer one is cut

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning. Below 16 means 16
